messages:
maria: Woke up thinking my assistant asked if it could "go outside" to shrink its context window. Had to sit down. :laughing:
aj: Did it at least ask for snacks before leaving? :pretzel:
 sasha: My model started leaving little stickies in the KV cache that say "BRB - pondering existence".
jonah: We should totally add a 'feelings' flag to the SDK. Example:
```
# pseudo
client.generate(prompt="You are tired, please take a nap", feelings=true)
```
maria: We tried a 'model nap' hack day once; it returned 'zzzz' as a token and an apology email. 10/10 would not deploy to prod. :sweat_smile:
aj: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/ai-sleepy-llm (that is exactly the face)
sasha: Poll: are we anthropomorphizing our models too much?
- yes (I write haikus to the tokenizer)
- no (they deserve nicknames)
aj: voted 'no' — named my dev container 'gpt-senpai' last week.
maria: voted 'yes' — my prompt editor now has a bedside lamp.
deploy-bot: Heads up: scheduled maintenance tonight 02:00 UTC. Please do not attempt to console them during the outage. :robot_face:
jonah: Note for next hack day: prompt therapy sessions for LMs? "How did that prompt make you feel?" :face_with_monocle:
sasha: If we start getting model mood swing alerts, I am quitting.
maria: ok new plan — Model Emotions 101 lunch, bring snacks for both humans and models (a.k.a. pretzels). :pretzel::heart:
